notes: Illustrative care-reward rates for the hosted Physician value panel (clinical_core/agere/hosted/value.py). They show how completed, receipted work could be credited to the attributed physician; they are NOT contracted rates and NOT payments. A customer replaces them with its own value-based contract terms. Each step is credited once per patient when a work item carries a receipt matching `match` (step + outcome) or a follow-on pathway reaches one of `states`.

pay_schedule.label: Paid on the 15th of the month after the step's receipt
